projects.name: VisionGuard
bullets: Built a real-time intelligent video analytics platform to deliver continuous, reliable monitoring on CPU-only hardware, using YOLO11 detection, ByteTrack tracking, and a 9-rule event engine (intrusion, loitering, line-crossing).
Architected with 12 enterprise design patterns and a publish/subscribe frame bus, served through a FastAPI + WebSocket API with an analytics dashboard.

projects.name: ResearchMate
bullets: Fine-tuned a 3B instruction model to answer research questions from scientific literature, using LoRA on a 3,000-example PubMedQA/arXiv instruction dataset with 4-bit quantization.
Evaluated base vs. fine-tuned models on latency, task quality, and hallucination behavior.
